svg.title: One turn of the OpenWiSH run loop
svg.desc: The agent replies with a python block. The run loop sends the block to the sandboxed Python kernel. save_edit goes to the edit gate, which checks the task policy, appends to edits/ledger.jsonl and rewrites edits/current/W.npy. The run loop logs the run and sends the output and the budget line back to the agent.
svg.text: One turn of the OpenWiSH run loop
tasks/toy with a scripted agent. Every message and file name below comes from a real run.

g.text: 1 The agent replies with one ```python block.
2 The run loop sends the block to the sandboxed Python kernel.
3 save_edit goes to the edit gate, which checks the task's policy.
4 The gate appends to the ledger and rewrites the current weights.
5 The run loop logs the run and counts the budget.
6 The output and the budget line go back to the agent.
reply → run loop → kernel → edit gate → ledger and weights → output and budget → agent
